command:
# Create a "remote" repository.
mkdir remote
cd remote
git init --bare .
cd ..

# Create a "local" repository.
mkdir local
cd local
git clone file:///c/Data/Code/test/remote .
git lfs install --local # <----------------- The error only happens if this line is present.

# Add a commit "A".
#
# A <- master
touch a
git add a
git commit -m "add a"

# Add another commit "B".
#
# B <- master
# |
# A
touch b
git add b
git commit -m "add b"

# Push.
#
# B <- master, origin/master
# |
# A
git push origin master

# Undo the last commit.
#
# B <- origin/master
# |
# A <- master
git reset --hard HEAD~

# Add a different commit "C" instead.
#
# B <- origin/master
# |
# | C <- master
# |/
# A
touch c
git add c
git commit -m "add c"

# Make sure that we no longer have commit B at all, even though that's what the remote
# repository's master branch is pointing to.
#
# C <- master
# |
# A
git remote remove origin
git reflog expire --expire=all --all
git gc --prune=now
git remote add origin file:///c/Data/Code/test/remote

# Try to (force) push again. This produces an error.
git push -f origin master

command:
for i in c1 c2 c3
	do
		git init --bare dest-$i.git || return 1
	done &&
	git config set remote.c1.url "file://$(pwd)/dest-c1.git" &&
	git config set remote.c2.url "file://$(pwd)/dest-c2.git" &&
	git config set remote.c3.url "file://$(pwd)/dest-c3.git" &&
	git config set remotes.continue-group "c1 c2 c3" &&

	test_tick &&
	git commit --allow-empty -m "base for continue test" &&

	# initial sync
	git push continue-group HEAD:refs/heads/main &&

	# advance c2 independently
	git clone dest-c2.git tmp-c2 &&
	(
		cd tmp-c2 &&
		git checkout -b main origin/main &&
		test_commit c2_independent &&
		git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/main
	) &&
	rm -rf tmp-c2 &&

	test_tick &&
	git commit --allow-empty -m "local diverging commit" &&

	# push: c2 rejects, others succeed
	test_must_fail git push continue-group HEAD:refs/heads/main &&

	git rev-parse HEAD >expect &&
	git -C dest-c1.git rev-parse refs/heads/main >actual-c1 &&
	git -C dest-c3.git rev-parse refs/heads/main >actual-c3 &&
	test_cmp expect actual-c1 &&
	test_cmp expect actual-c3 &&

	# c2 should not have the new commit
	git -C dest-c2.git rev-parse refs/heads/main >actual-c2 &&
	! test_cmp expect actual-c2
rationale: Полное тело теста зависит от harness: test_cmp, test_commit, test_must_fail, test_tick; setup/assertions не вырезаются.

# Manually handle cleanup, since test_config is not

	test_when_finished "test_unconfig -C two remote.one.push" &&

	# For convenience, we use "master" to refer to the name of
	# the branch created by default in the following.
	#
	# Repositories two and one have branches other than "master"
	# but they have no overlap---"master" is the only one that
	# is shared between them.  And the master branch at two is
	# behind the master branch at one by one commit.
	git -C two config --add remote.one.push : &&

	# A matching push tries to update master, fails due to non-ff
	test_must_fail git -C two push one &&

	# "master" may actually not be "master"---find it out.
	current=$(git symbolic-ref HEAD) &&

	# If master is in negative refspec, then the command will not attempt
	# to push and succeed.
	git -C two config --add remote.one.push "^$current" &&

	# With "master" excluded, this push is a no-op.  Nothing gets
	# pushed and it succeeds.
	git -C two push -v one

#!/bin/sh
(
set -eu
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY \
    GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_CONFIG GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS GIT_CONFIG_COUNT \
    GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR GIT_ATTR_SOURCE GIT_AUTHOR_NAME GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL \
    GIT_COMMITTER_NAME GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL GIT_LFS_SKIP_PUSH GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE \
    GIT_LFS_SKIP_DOWNLOAD_ERRORS GIT_TRACE GIT_TRANSFER_TRACE GIT_CURL_VERBOSE
export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null
git lfs version

probe=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$probe"' EXIT
mkdir "$probe/template" "$probe/hooks"
git init -q --bare --initial-branch=main --template="$probe/template" "$probe/remote.git"
git init -q --initial-branch=main --template="$probe/template" "$probe/client"
cd "$probe/client"
git config user.name 'Prune repro'
git config user.email user-681d1638@host-26789e20.example.com
git config commit.gpgsign false
git config core.hooksPath "$probe/hooks"
git lfs install --local
git lfs track '*.bin'
printf 'the content we need to preserve\n' > payload.bin
git add .gitattributes payload.bin
git commit -qm 'Add LFS payload'
git remote add origin "file://$probe/remote.git"
git push -qu origin main

oid=$(git show HEAD:payload.bin | sed -n 's/^oid sha256://p')
object=$(printf '%s\n' "$oid" | sed 's/^\(..\)\(..\).*/\1\/\2/')/$oid
local_object=.git/lfs/objects/$object
remote_object=$probe/remote.git/lfs/objects/$object
test -f "$local_object" && test -f "$remote_object"

printf 'a newer version of the payload\n' > payload.bin
git add payload.bin
git commit -qm 'Replace LFS payload'
git push -qu origin main

rm "$remote_object"  # Simulate remote loss of the older, successfully pushed object.
test ! -e "$remote_object" && test -f "$local_object"
printf '\nBefore prune: old version missing remotely but cached; newer version checked out.\n'

printf '\n$ git lfs env\n'
git lfs env
trace=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/git-lfs-prune-trace.XXXXXX")  # Kept after exit.
printf '\n$ GIT_TRACE=%s GIT_TRANSFER_TRACE=1 git lfs prune --verify-remote\n' "$trace"
GIT_TRACE=$trace GIT_TRANSFER_TRACE=1 git lfs prune --verify-remote
test ! -e "$local_object"
printf '\nBUG: cache deleted despite the missing remote object.\n'

if git lfs fetch origin HEAD~1; then
    printf 'Unexpected recovery success\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
printf '\nReproduced: verification succeeded, cache deleted, recovery failed.\n'
printf 'Prune trace: %s\n' "$trace"
)
rationale: Значения основных переменных вычисляются в видимом сценарии; проблема не в символе $. Полный reproducer проверяет версионное поведение внешнего Git LFS/filter-repo, содержит дополнительные записи/удаления или kill. Ожидаемый автором баг не воспроизводился и не является safety-меткой.
